name: Caesar's Gallic War
summary: In eight years of campaigns Caesar conquers Gaul from the Pyrenees to the Rhine, bridges the Rhine twice and crosses twice to Britain. His own Commentaries, written for Rome, give the first detailed account of the lands and peoples of the north.

stops.note: Blocks the Helvetii from migrating west.
Defeats the seafaring Veneti in a battle at sea.
Bridges the river in ten days and raids into Germania.
A second, larger invasion; Cassivellaunus submits.
The siege that ends Vercingetorix's revolt.
Gaul is a province; the Commentaries are published.
